hero.title: From the Mediterranean
hero.subtitle: To Your Plate
hero.tagline: A carefully curated and beautifully interpreted presentation of Mediterranean cuisine

subtitles.salads_note: All our salads are dressed with cold-pressed extra virgin olive oil and fresh farm herbs.

meze_platter.title: MEDITERRANEAN MEZE SELECTION
meze_platter.description: Hummus, roasted eggplant mutabbal, fava bean dip, muhammara, served with warm flatbread.

calamari_fritti.title: CRISPY CALAMARI FRITTI
calamari_fritti.description: Lightly battered squid rings served with homemade herb tarator dip and fresh lemon wedges.

grilled_halloumi.title: CHAR-GRILLED HALLOUMI
grilled_halloumi.description: Served with roasted vine tomatoes, fresh basil leaves, and pomegranate reduction.

mediterranean_breeze.title: MEDITERRANEAN BREEZE SALAD
mediterranean_breeze.description: Fresh Mediterranean greens, cherry tomatoes, aged feta cheese, walnuts, Kalamata olives, and basil vinaigrette.

burrata_caprese.title: BURRATA & FRESH FIG SALAD
burrata_caprese.description: Creamy Italian burrata cheese, roasted fresh figs, wild arugula, and glaze balsamic.

grilled_sea_bass.title: GRILLED SEA BASS FILLET
grilled_sea_bass.description: Served with steamed seasonal vegetables, roasted baby potatoes, and lemon caper emulsion.

mediterranean_lamb_chop.title: HERB-CRUSTED LAMB CHOPS
mediterranean_lamb_chop.description: Marinated with fresh rosemary and garlic, served with saffron couscous and grilled vegetables.

seafood_linguine.title: SEAFOOD LINGUINE
seafood_linguine.description: Artisanal linguine pasta with prawns, calamari, mussels, fresh garlic, cherry tomatoes, and extra virgin olive oil.

citrus_panna_cotta.title: CITRUS PANNA COTTA
citrus_panna_cotta.description: Classic Italian dessert infused with local mandarin and orange reduction.

baklava_ice_cream.title: CRISPY BAKLAVA & ICE CREAM
baklava_ice_cream.description: Layers of crispy pistachio baklava pastry served with authentic goat milk ice cream.

aboutPage.title: Our Story
aboutPage.text: Akdeniz Restaurant, which began as a mobile business run by our elders in 1930 and has since grown into a large restaurant, is delighted to welcome its guests with the same passion and flavor. comments.1: Everything was a wonderful taste experience and the atmosphere was perfect for a romantic evening.
comments.2: A fantastic kitchen experience directly from the Mediterranean.
comments.3: The service was excellent and the dishes were beautifully presented.
comments.4: The flavors were fresh and the ingredients were of high quality.
comments.5: A perfect place for a special occasion or a casual dinner with friends.
comments.6: The desserts were delicious and the coffee was excellent.
comments.7: The staff was friendly and attentive, making us feel welcome.
comments.8: The restaurant has a warm and inviting atmosphere, perfect for a relaxing evening.
